COGS 200.title: Introduction to Cognitive Systems
COGS 200.description: Interdisciplinary examination of human mental processes and how these are mediated by the brain. Will draw on cognitive psychology, linguistics, cognitive neuroscience, philosophy, artificial intelligence.

prerequisite.raw: 2nd-year class standing or higher in the Faculty of Arts or Science

COGS 200.prerequisiteText: 2nd-year class standing or higher in the Faculty of Arts or Science

COGS 300.title: Understanding and Designing Cognitive Systems
COGS 300.description: Theory and methods for integrating diverse disciplinary content in cognitive systems. Students who have earned four credits from COGS_V 300A may take COGS_V 300B for a further four credits, and vice versa.

COGS 303.title: Research Methods in Cognitive Systems
COGS 303.description: Examination and comparison of the research methodologies of different disciplines relevant to cognitive systems.

COGS 401.title: Seminar in Cognitive Systems
COGS 401.description: Interdisciplinary seminar integrating theory, methods, and current research topics.

COGS 402.title: Research in Cognitive Systems
COGS 402.description: Supervised research project in a Cognitive Systems-related laboratory.
